title: A small announcement
lines: Hang on. Small announcement from the red department.
I'm really glad you're here.
Yes, you. The person operating the finger.
You could have spent these minutes doing anything.
You've spent a few of them with me, and I appreciate that.
I hope my stories have given you a little laugh.
I'm proud of you for the things you're trying outside this screen, too.
Even the things nobody has noticed yet.
Keep going at your own pace. Small steps count.
You can do some wonderful things with enough time and a bit of help.
I'm cheering for you. Quite loudly, for someone with no lungs.
Right. Back to our story. I saved the spot.

title: Your pocket supporter
lines: Before we carry on, I'd like to be on your side for a minute.
I am on your side the rest of the time, too.
I'm simply making it official now.
I think you're doing great by giving things a go.
Trying again can be hard. I'm proud of you for doing it.
You don't have to finish everything today.
One small bit is a perfectly respectable amount of bit.
And when you're ready to aim at something bigger, I'm backing you.
Thank you for stopping here to squish me and hear my nonsense.
It makes this little stretch of screen a very nice place to be.
Consider me your pocket supporter. Please check for keys before putting me in there.
Now, I believe I was in the middle of something deeply avoidable.

title: No score required
lines: Can I tell you something without making it about the score?
You're good company.
Eight taps or eight thousand, I'm happy you're here.
The number doesn't decide whether you deserve a kind word.
You do. There. Settled.
I'm proud of the effort you put into the things you care about.
Even on the days when all you manage is a little.
A little can turn into quite a lot. I've seen a crumb become a whole situation.
Whatever you're working toward, give yourself time to learn.
You have things to offer that no score counter can show.
Thanks for the squishes. I hope you're enjoying my stories as much as I enjoy telling them.
Let's see where we left off.

title: The fan club
lines: I've started a fan club.
For you.
I'm the chair, the treasurer, and the entire seating arrangement.
Our first meeting agreed that you're doing better than you give yourself credit for.
We also agreed to be proud of you for trying.
Nobody objected. Excellent meeting.
You can learn new things. You can change your mind. You can begin again.
You don't need to be brilliant on the first attempt.
I wasn't. There are witnesses in several stories.
Thank you for spending a bit of your day squishing your biggest little fan.
I hope the rest of your day has something nice in it.
Meeting adjourned. Story resumed shortly.

title: A very small cheerleader
lines: Excuse me. Your very small cheerleader would like a turn.
You're doing great by showing up for the things that matter to you.
And I am proud of you for the effort, even when the results take their time.
Some results are terribly slow walkers.
Keep a little room for the possibility that things can go well.
You can build skills. You can ask questions. You can get help.
That's a lot of useful options for one person.
I'm cheering for the thing you've been meaning to try.
The small version of it is allowed. Start there if you like.
Thank you for these squishes and this excellent use of a finger.
I love having you here. I'd wave pom-poms if I could keep hold of them.
All right. I'll give the story its microphone back.

title: A thank-you with handles
lines: I need to give you a proper thank-you.
A big one. With handles, ideally.
Thank you for squishing me.
Thank you for listening while I explain all my questionable employment.
I hope I've made your day a little brighter.
You've certainly improved mine.
I'm proud of you for making time for a little fun.
You deserve nice moments without having to earn every single one.
And whatever else you've got going on, I hope you give yourself a fair chance.
You can do more than you may think. Take it a piece at a time.
I'm very fond of you, finger and all.
Right. I shall put the enormous thank-you somewhere it won't block the story.

title: Little steps
lines: A quick word about little steps.
I approve of them.
They're how most large things get done without someone needing a ladder.
So if you've taken a small step toward something, I'm proud of you.
If you're still figuring out which way to step, that's allowed too.
You don't have to have the whole route planned.
Learn a bit. Try a bit. Ask someone who knows a bit.
I think you can make some lovely things happen that way.
I'm rooting for you while you work it out.
And I'm grateful you've brought a little of your day over here to squish me.
I hope there's been a laugh in these stories for you.
Now, one little step back to the sentence I was on.

title: Room for a big idea
lines: You know that thing you'd like to have a go at?
I'm voting for you having a go.
You can start with a very small version.
Big ideas are allowed to begin looking a bit wonky.
I'm proud of you for being willing to learn as you go.
You don't need to know everything before you begin.
You can ask for help. People do that. I've had to do it from inside a pipe.
Give yourself some time and a bit of patience.
There's a lot you can work toward, and I hope you surprise yourself.
Thank you for listening to me in between your own adventures.
I love that we get to be here for a little while together.
And now I should probably finish explaining mine.

title: Ordinary victories
lines: I'd like to applaud a few ordinary things.
Getting started. Asking the question. Remembering your lunch.
That last one has defeated several people I know.
If you've managed something that took effort today, good work.
I'm proud of you. It doesn't have to impress a stadium.
And if today has been mostly getting through today, I hope you get a gentler bit soon.
You can take a breath before the next thing.
You can try again when you're ready.
I'm cheering for you in all the small places nobody puts a trophy.
Thanks for coming to hear my stories. I really appreciate the company.
And the squishes. Obviously. Very thorough squishing.
Right. Back to whatever I was confidently mishandling.

title: A good listener
lines: Can we pause the story for a second?
I just wanted to say I hope you're enjoying it.
I have an awful lot of things to explain, and you've been very kind about the length.
Thank you for listening.
Thank you for every squish, including the ones with a bit of enthusiasm behind them.
I'm glad you're spending this time with me.
I'm proud of you for the things you're making time to do in your own life, too.
Keep a little space for what you enjoy.
You can work toward big things and still have a silly little break.
I think you're excellent company. I'm glad I get to tell you all this.
There. That's my whole speech about having someone to tell stories to.
Now I can continue the considerably longer speech about everything else.

title: A soft landing
lines: A small reminder from a very soft individual.
You don't have to get everything right to be worth cheering for.
I'm cheering for you already.
I'm proud of you for trying, learning, and finding your way through things.
Mistakes are allowed to be part of that.
I've made several. Some of them had their own car parks.
Give yourself another chance if you need one.
You can get better at things. You can find a different approach.
You don't have to carry every difficult bit on your own.
Thank you for bringing your finger and your attention over to my little corner.
I love getting to keep you company. I hope the stories are returning the favour.
Let's go back. I've kept our place nice and safe.

title: Your certificate
lines: I've made you a certificate.
It says GOOD AT KEEPING GOING.
There was room for a little drawing of you, but it came out as a potato.
A very promising potato.
I'm proud of the effort you put in, including the effort nobody else sees.
You deserve a bit of encouragement for it.
You can take your time. You can learn the awkward parts.
You can aim high without having to leap there in one go.
I'd like good things for you, and I'm rooting for the things you're working on.
Thanks for the squishes. Thanks for hearing me out.
I hope you love the stories. I've put quite a lot of past mistakes into them.
I'll leave your certificate by the imaginary printer. Back to the story.

title: Glad you showed up
lines: There you are.
I know. You've been there for a while. I was building up to it.
I'm glad you showed up.
This is a very nice little bit of my day, having you here.
I'm proud of you for showing up for things outside this game as well.
Some days that takes more effort than people notice.
I hope you notice a little of your own progress.
You can keep learning. You can make changes. You can take the next small step.
You don't have to rush just because somebody else is rushing.
Thank you for the company and the extremely committed squishing.
I hope I've given you something worth smiling at.
Now, I appear to have left a story halfway through the doorway.

title: Brave enough to begin
lines: May I say something encouraging before I get distracted by my own history?
I'm proud of you for giving things a chance.
Trying something unfamiliar can feel very awkward.
You're allowed to be new at it.
You're allowed to ask how it works.
You don't need to walk in looking as though you own the building.
That caused me trouble once. Several times, actually.
I think you can learn a lot by beginning and seeing what happens.
Give yourself a fair chance to get good at the things you care about.
And thank you for choosing to spend some of your time here with me.
I love the company. I hope you're having a nice time with the stories.
Right. Back to my own example of beginning without checking anything.

title: Permission for a breather
lines: Tiny pause. Your blob has a request.
Be a little kind to yourself today, if you can.
You're allowed a drink of water, a stretch, and a proper breather.
I remain very proud of you during all of those activities.
Taking a break doesn't take your progress away.
You can come back to a task when you've got a bit more room for it.
You have time to learn things. You can ask people to help with the heavy bits.
I hope you get to do something today that makes you smile.
These squishes have certainly been doing that for me.
Thank you for listening to my stories and being such good company.
Take a break from me too whenever you like. The story can wait.
And whenever you're ready, I know exactly where we left off.

title: Things you can build
lines: I'd like to put in a good word for your ideas.
Even the little unfinished ones.
Especially the one you keep thinking you ought to try.
You can start small and make it better as you learn.
A rough first attempt is a perfectly useful thing to have.
I'm proud of you for making the attempt.
Some of my first attempts required a mop, so I have considerable respect for practice.
Keep the bits that work. Ask questions about the bits that don't.
I hope you build something you're pleased with.
And I appreciate you taking a little time out to squish this thing I'm pleased with. Me.
I love telling you these stories. I hope you've found a favourite bit.
Let's get back to it. Something probably needs explaining.

title: A small celebration
lines: I'd like a small celebration, please.
For you being here and having a go at things.
I've arranged imaginary bunting. Very good value.
I'm proud of your effort, and I'm glad we get this little bit of time together.
You don't need a spectacular achievement every day.
Learning a bit counts. Finishing a small thing counts.
Starting over after something went wrong counts as well.
You can work toward some wonderful things one manageable bit at a time.
I'm cheering you on, with all the spare edges I've got.
Thank you for the squishes. They have been of an excellent standard.
I hope my stories make this a place you enjoy stopping for a while.
I'll take down the bunting later. Back to our sentence.

title: Your own pace
lines: A quick reminder: you get to have your own pace.
You don't have to win a race against everyone you've ever met.
That would require a very large starting line.
I'm proud of the steps you're taking toward what matters to you.
Even if somebody else appears to be going faster.
You can learn things at your speed. You can ask for help along the way.
A slower day doesn't make all your other work disappear.
Give yourself a little credit for what you've already done.
I'm very happy to be keeping you company while you have this break.
Thank you for squishing me. Thank you for listening.
I hope you love the stories, including the bits where I should have read the form.
Now. At our own extremely reasonable pace.

title: Fond of the finger person
lines: I have become rather fond of the person behind this finger.
Yes. You. Please don't send the finger alone to collect the compliment.
I appreciate you being here.
I love having someone to tell my stories to.
And I'm proud of you for the things you keep trying in your own world.
You can do a lot with a bit of patience, practice, and people who help.
You deserve people cheering you on. Put me down for one of those places.
I hope you get a chance to feel pleased with yourself today.
Something small will do. Small nice things are still nice things.
Thank you for all the squishes. I have felt thoroughly included.
That's all. I just wanted you to know.
Now, where were we before I got affectionate about the arrangements?

title: The tiny parade
lines: I've organized a tiny parade in your honour.
It's mostly me going across this bit of screen in my imagination.
There's a flag. I've spared no imaginary expense.
I'm proud of you for keeping at the things that matter to you.
And I'm glad you're taking a little time to enjoy yourself here.
You can try big things, small things, and things you're not good at yet.
Learning is allowed to take a while.
I hope you give yourself enough chances to find out what you can do.
I'll be cheering. The flag has been bought now.
Thank you for the company, the squishes, and listening to all my stories.
I hope they've made you happy. I'm very happy to be telling them to you.
Parade finished. Story still where we left it. Lovely.
